name: Eco Park
description: is a lush, 20-hectare recreation and eco-tourism site located in the Ahala neighborhood in the southern suburbs of Yaoundé, Cameroon. It blends nature, local wildlife, and leisure, serving as a peaceful green escape for families, tourists, and nature lovers right outside the bustling capital.
bonASavoir: The entry fee for EcoPark Yaoundé starts at 500 FCFA for adults and 250 FCFA for children under 5 years old.Swimming Pool Access: 2,500 FCFA for adults and 1,500 FCFA for children.Pirogue (Boat Ride): 1,000 FCFA per person.Hotel Lodging: Rooms at the on-site hotel start at 35,000 FCFA per
